_comment: Tool to region map of the brain page. Single source for local/hooks/brain-emit.py: every move of the agent produces ONE pulse through here. Valid regions: dlpfc, apfc, ofc, atl, post, hip, tha, amy, bg, cb, vta, hypo. Rationale: dlpfc=working memory · apfc=executive control · ofc=checking against what is real · atl=semantic memory · post=episodic memory and perception · hip=encoding · tha=replay · amy=salience (an error, the human) · bg=procedural (execute) · cb=reflexes (the guards) · vta=forgetting · hypo=homeostatic alarm (compaction). An MCP tool is named without its mcp__ prefix, with single underscores.
